name: WM-811K (dataset paper)
description: Wafer-map pattern recognition. The dataset paper introduces a large collection of wafer maps and the pattern-recognition problem.

name: MixedWM38
description: Wafer maps with single and mixed defect patterns, download links and baseline code. The release includes generated maps used to balance patterns.

name: MIIC
description: SEM images of integrated circuits for anomaly detection and localization, with bounding boxes and pixel masks. The project specifies non-commercial research use.

name: LithoBench
description: Circuit-layout datasets and a learning framework for lithography simulation and mask optimization, with baseline models.

name: OpenILT
description: An implementation platform for inverse lithography, including lithography models, mask optimizers and benchmark examples.

name: SECOM
description: Process measurements and pass/fail outcomes for feature selection and quality classification: 1,567 examples, 591 features and missing values.

name: PySCFabSim
description: A semiconductor fab simulator with dispatching experiments and reinforcement-learning interfaces. Its documentation links to the SMT2020 testbed.
